description:
This request adds a time tracking transaction to QuickBooks, mirroring the time-tracking feature available in the QuickBooks UI. The time tracking feature allows a QuickBooks user to base payroll or invoices on time worked. You can add time-tracking information to any vendor, employee, or person on the Other Names list in QuickBooks.

The `time_tracking_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

customer_ref.description: `customer_ref` identifies a customer or customer job. If both `full_name` and `list_id` are provided, `full_name` is ignored. In SalesReceipt and ReceivePayment, it identifies who receives credit.

duration.description: Time spent doing the work. In a TimeTrackAdd request, notice that although you can specify seconds, seconds aren’t returned in the response because the UI doesn’t use seconds.

entity_ref.description: A QuickBooks “entity” is a customer, vendor, employee, or person on the QuickBooks “other names” list. Special cases to note: In a BillToPayQuery message, `entity_ref` refers to the vendor name.

item_service_ref.description: A service item refers to services that a business charges for or purchases. Examples include specialized labor, consulting hours, and professional fees.

payroll_item_wage_ref.description: Each payroll wage item describes and names a payment scheme, for example, Regular Pay or Overtime Pay. A `payroll_item_wage_ref` aggregate refers to one of these wage items.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

txn_date.description: The date of the transaction. In some cases, if you leave `txn_date` out of an -Add message, QuickBooks will prefill `txn_date` with the date of the last-saved transaction of the same type.
